claims.statement: Directive (EU) 2020/2184 calls for risk assessment of domestic distribution systems and proportionate Legionella control measures, particularly in priority premises.
ECDC maintains recurring EU and EEA surveillance reports for Legionnaires' disease.

contrary_evidence: Laboratories and facility-management vendors may already include basic trend reports at no extra charge.

economics.acquisition_route: One-to-many distribution through accredited water laboratories, facility-management groups, and insurers.
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Hypothesis: ten laboratories each contributing 5000 annual samples at 80 PLN plus subscriptions yields over 4 million PLN revenue by year five and can support founder equity above 5 million PLN without double-counting cash.
economics.founder_time: Hypothesis: 3 founder hours daily on analytics and partner operations while laboratories own sampling and validated results.
economics.gross_margin_basis: Hypothesis: 65-75% gross margin after laboratory share, expert escalation, reporting, and secure data operations.
economics.payback: Hypothesis: a 15000 PLN laboratory integration pays back within a year at 2500 annual samples.
economics.pricing: Hypothesis, including the capital figure: 80 PLN per analyzed sample plus 2400 PLN annually per multi-site property portfolio.
economics.retention_or_repeat: Every scheduled sampling round, remediation retest, and annual risk review is separately paid.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Opt-in water-system features, interventions, and retest outcomes improve comparable-building risk baselines
fingerprint.customer: Hotels, care facilities, hospitals, and multi-site property managers
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Accredited laboratory result portals and facility-management contracts
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Partner-branded environmental risk analytics sold per sample and portfolio-year
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: The property operator pays when a lab-issued trend and control report is delivered
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A scheduled water sample, remediation retest, or building risk review occurs

founder_fit: The health-monitoring theme and statistical benchmarking fit the founder while partners handle all physical sampling.
risks: Reports must not replace accredited testing or public-health decisions and must make uncertainty and urgent escalation explicit.

structure.control_point: The interpretation layer between an accredited sample result and the next building-control action
structure.critical_dependency: Accredited laboratory partners and lawful rights to pseudonymized building-level environmental data

thesis: Let accredited laboratories attach a building-specific trend and control report to each Legionella sampling round, with property owners funding repeat events and opt-in environmental results compounding a risk benchmark.
title: Legionella Lab Risk Benchmark
uncertainties: No evidence yet shows laboratories will share intervention and retest outcomes under reusable rights.
